hooks.command:
cmd=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty' 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$cmd" ] && exit 0; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE 'jamf-cli' || exit 0; echo "$cmd" | grep -qE ' (create|update|apply|patch) ' || exit 0; echo "$cmd" | grep -q -- '--scaffold' && exit 0; printf '[jamf-cli] Spec check required before this mutation.
Load the API spec first (WebFetch), then run --scaffold to get the exact template.
  Platform (blueprints/compliance-benchmarks/platform-devices/platform-device-groups/ddm-reports):
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jamf-Concepts/jamf-cli/main/specs/platform/<resource>-api.json
  Classic API (/JSSResource/ paths):
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jamf-Concepts/jamf-cli/main/specs/classic/resources.yaml
  Pro modern API (all other resources):
    https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jamf-Concepts/jamf-cli/main/specs/<ResourceName>.yaml
' >&2; exit 0
